findings.comment: Existing Conditions Survey (Sheet 4) was performed without the benefit of a current title commitment and notes that easements may exist but are not shown or verified. Metes and bounds descriptions and surveyor-sealed field notes for all electric easements cannot be verified from submitted documentation.

applicableAreas: All proposed and existing electric easements on site
findings.comment: Title commitment, title policy, Ownership and Encumbrance Report, or ALTA/ACSM boundary survey showing all easement encumbrances has not been submitted to Austin Energy for review. No title documentation was found in supplementary documents.

applicableAreas: Electrical design sheets - proposed underground electric lines
findings.comment: The Preliminary Electrical Design Plan (Sheet 21) depicts underground electric distribution lines looping throughout the site without showing the lines contained within or clearly aligned to the depicted electric easement boundaries. Proposed electric facilities must be shown within dedicated easement corridors on all electrical design sheets.

applicableAreas: Landscape areas adjacent to overhead electric line - southern property boundary
findings.comment: Mitigation trees are proposed directly adjacent to and within the overhead electric line corridor along the southern boundary per the Landscape Plan (Sheet 31). License agreement from Austin Energy Public Involvement must be obtained for all landscaping, trees, and irrigation within electric easements and to be submitted prior to plan approval.

applicableAreas: Cover sheet and/or electric notes section
findings.comment: Required plan note is missing: 'Austin Energy has the right to prune and/or remove trees, shrubbery and other obstructions to keep easements clear in compliance with Chapter 25-8, Subchapter B of the City of Austin Land Development Code.' This note must be added to the Cover Sheet or Electric Notes section.

applicableAreas: Cover sheet and/or electric notes section
findings.comment: Required plan note is missing: 'Owner/developer shall provide Austin Energy with easements and/or access required for installation and ongoing maintenance of electric facilities without causing site non-compliance with Chapter 25-8.' This note must be added to the Cover Sheet or Electric Notes section.

applicableAreas: Grading plan - areas with existing overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: Required plan note is missing: 'Owner/developer is responsible for all costs associated with raising electric lines and attachments if final grades do not meet required clearances for Austin Energy facilities and franchised attachments.' Grading near the overhead electric line along the southern boundary must include this note.

applicableAreas: Landscape plan and electric notes - area within 10 feet of overhead electric line centerline
findings.comment: Required plan note is missing: 'Owner shall be responsible for initial tree pruning and tree removal within 10 feet of centerline of proposed overhead electrical facilities, temporary erosion control, revegetation, and tree protection, and shall include Austin Energy's work within limits of construction.' Landscape plan shows trees within 10 feet of overhead electric line but lacks this required note.

applicableAreas: Cover sheet and/or electric notes section
findings.comment: Required plan note is missing: 'Owner is responsible for maintaining clearances required by NESC, NEC, OSHA, City rules, and Texas state laws when working near overhead power lines; Austin Energy will not render service unless clearances maintained; all costs for non-compliance charged to owner.' This note must be added to the Cover Sheet or Electric Notes section.

applicableAreas: Electric notes section or utility coordination notes
findings.comment: Required plan note is missing: 'Any relocation of electric facilities shall be at landowner's/developer's expense.' This note must be added to the Electric Notes or Austin Energy Notes section to establish cost responsibility.
